model.target: First commercial inactivity episode within 30 days among currently active purchasers. Product-specific refill date plus 14-day grace; future orders extend coverage.
model.explanation: Signed one-feature replacement sensitivity against training medians, through the calibrated model. Associations are not causes.

forecast.method: 95% conditional Poisson-binomial simulation interval; assumes independent customers and fixed calibrated probabilities. Excludes parameter uncertainty and domain shift.
